## [Launch Contractor - Uruguay→](https://windbornesystems.com/careers/launch-contractor-uruguay)

- Uruguay

Launch high-altitude weather balloons in Artigas, Uruguay. This part-time contractor role combines hands-on outdoor work with equipment preparation, safety procedures, and flexible shifts.

## [Launch Operator - Alabama→](https://windbornesystems.com/careers/launch-operator-alabama)

- Alabama

Launch high-altitude weather balloons and support prototype hardware near Bay Minette, Alabama. This part-time contractor role offers approximately 10–20 hours per week across evenings, weekdays, and weekends.

## [Launch Operator - Oahu→](https://windbornesystems.com/careers/launch-operator-oahu)

- Hawaii

We are hiring a part-time balloon launch contractor based in Oahu, HI to support our weather forecasting mission. You'll be launching high-altitude weather balloons that collect atmospheric data used to improve forecasts for events like hurricanes and wildfires. The role is hands-on and outdoors, with flexible hours — approximately 10–20 hours per week, depending on the company's launch needs — across evenings, weekdays, and weekends.

## [Production Manager→](https://windbornesystems.com/careers/production-manager)

- California

Lead WindBorne’s manufacturing line and technician team, manage daily production, troubleshoot challenges, and improve quality, workflow, and output.

## [Senior Manufacturing Engineer→](https://windbornesystems.com/careers/senior-manufacturing-engineer)

- California

This is an atypical position: most hardware isn’t at design lock, but we produce it at volume (currently 1,000 units a month, doubling every six months). We need someone to make decisions on which parts of a design are stable enough to tool up and document, and which need to stay flexible, as well as the engineering rigor to build repeatable, sustainable production around a moving target. If that seems exciting, this job might be for you.

## [Sensor Data Engineer→](https://windbornesystems.com/careers/sensor-data-engineer)

- California

Own the software that turns raw weather-balloon measurements into trusted observations. Build sensor-processing pipelines, improve quality control, and investigate data issues.

## [Web Handling/Film Converting Expert→](https://windbornesystems.com/careers/web-handling-film-converting-expert)

- California

Scale WindBorne’s balloon manufacturing with expertise in thin films, web handling, and film converting. Design production systems and work closely with the CTO and R&D team.
